nodes.label: Nomisma agent coordination policy
nodes.rationale: The main agent owns integration and evidence; specialists receive explicit scope, file ownership and checks. Independent review, reproducible execution and exact-version risk assessment precede conclusions. Delegated agents do not recursively delegate without authorization.

nodes.label: infra_engineer
nodes.rationale: Owns environments, dependencies, reproducible execution, integration tests, offline backtests, logging and operational tooling; reports actual evidence without treating missing results as passes.

nodes.label: Research and execution boundaries
nodes.rationale: Research and offline backtesting are the default. Paper execution needs explicit scope; live orders and live deployment are prohibited. Risk sign-off is advisory, and final reports must distinguish executed checks from missing evidence.
